_comment: LCSC part assignments for JLCPCB PCBA, keyed by KiCad footprint name (the 'Package' column from `kicad-cli pcb export pos`). scripts/gen-jlcpcb-bom-cpl.py joins this against the position file to emit BOM/CPL. See v4/README.md 'Fabrication (JLCPCB)' for which parts are placed and which are hand-soldered.

diode_sod123.note: 1N4148W (C81598). JLCPCB's footprint for C81598 puts pad 1 (cathode) on the same side as this footprint's pad 1; the 180 is the bottom-side placement correction for a footprint reported at 0 degrees, so the band lands on pad 1 (cathode/row net). Verify in DFM. Tier/alternates: see v4/README.md BOM.

D_SOD-123FL.note: Littelfuse SMF5.0CA. Bidirectional, so rotation is irrelevant. Tier/stock/alternates: see v4/README.md BOM.

SW_TACT_ALPS_SKQGABE010.note: ALPS SKQGABE010 5.2mm tact switch, the MCU reset. Footprint matches JLCPCB's KEY-SMD_4P-L5.2-W5.2-P3.70-LS6.4 at 0 degrees; each pad row is one terminal pair, so 0 and 180 are equivalent and a 90-degree error leaves the terminals off their pads. Verify in DFM.
